## Summary

This nuclei fork's historical security posture centers on sandbox enforcement and file-access containment across template processing, payload loading, headless browsing, and workflow scripting. Recurring themes are path traversal via insufficient canonicalization (zip-slip in updates, payload file reads) and sandbox escapes through overly permissive script imports or browser sandbox disabling. Critical gaps involve gating privileged operations (file:// reads, unsafe script modules, browser sandbox) behind explicit flags or privilege checks, with multiple fixes touching the same sinks (SetImports, file path joins) indicating incomplete coverage. Developers should treat every file-loading and script-execution path as a sandbox boundary, applying canonicalization, allowlists, and opt-in flags consistently across all entry points.

## Top Risks

### 1. Sandbox Escape: `v2/internal/runner/processor.go` (high)

Workflow script imports were restricted to a safe module allowlist, but two separate fixes were needed, indicating the initial allowlist was incomplete and the same sink (SetImports) remains a high-risk execution boundary.

Evidence: cf2a98b03d76327c20fb0183b7f1c849eb692c91, 96049a32fa70aef0483d4180d386a57b3c2d973a

### 2. Path Traversal: `v2/internal/runner/update.go` (high)

Zip-slip in template extraction allowed writing files outside the template directory via crafted archive names; fixed by canonicalizing and prefix-checking paths, a classic and easily reintroduced flaw.

Evidence: f9c214a66f37a00fc29fe64232b690e6285ec59c

### 3. Local File Access / Path Traversal: `v2/pkg/protocols/headless/engine/page_actions.go` (high)

Headless FilesInput action could read arbitrary local files via file:// scheme unless explicitly gated behind AllowLocalFileAccess flag; a missing flag check on any sibling action would re-expose local reads.

Evidence: d3928e080d819f25306bfbaecc399f03516db5aa

### 4. Path Traversal: `v2/pkg/protocols/common/generators/load.go` (high)

Payload file loading lacked path canonicalization, allowing traversal outside the template directory when sandbox enabled; the fix added prefix checks, but other loaders may still be missing them.

Evidence: e7fb40a41308f6c41267e858d1781eb67f7e0572

### 5. Sandbox Escape: `v2/pkg/protocols/headless/engine/engine.go` (high)

Browser sandbox was disabled unconditionally; the fix made it conditional on OS and user privileges, but any code path that re-enables NoSandbox without privilege checks would reintroduce the escape.

Evidence: df55f7a2eb591a7949b5c66a9c54db54aa28f450

## Shared Attack Surfaces

Capabilities guarded by more than one past fix on different code paths. A guard enforced on one entry point is often missing on a sibling; verify each alternate path before assuming it's covered.

### 1. File-system path resolution and file read/write operations

- Guard that should hold everywhere: Canonicalize path (filepath.Abs/Clean), verify resolved path is within allowed root (template directory or payload dir), enforce AllowLocalFileAccess flag for file:// scheme
- Entry points: `v2/pkg/protocols/common/generators/load.go (loadPayloadsFromFile)`, `v2/internal/runner/update.go (filepath.Join in template extraction)`, `v2/pkg/protocols/headless/engine/page_actions.go (FilesInput action)`
- Check: Inspect any other payload loader or template extraction routine (e.g., workflow sub-loaders, remote template fetch) to confirm they apply the same canonicalization and prefix check, and that headless file actions all respect AllowLocalFileAccess.
- Evidence: e7fb40a41308f6c41267e858d1781eb67f7e0572, f9c214a66f37a00fc29fe64232b690e6285ec59c, d3928e080d819f25306bfbaecc399f03516db5aa

### 2. Script/module execution in workflow templates

- Guard that should hold everywhere: Restrict script imports to a safe module allowlist (SetImports with curated stdlib modules, not AllModuleNames)
- Entry points: `v2/internal/runner/processor.go (workflow script execution)`
- Check: Verify any alternate script execution path (e.g., JavaScript/headless script actions, template pre-processors) enforces the same allowlist; the two fixes indicate the allowlist evolved and may still miss modules on other paths.
- Evidence: cf2a98b03d76327c20fb0183b7f1c849eb692c91, 96049a32fa70aef0483d4180d386a57b3c2d973a

## Fixed-Issue Fingerprints

These are real security fixes mined from git history. Use them as regression checks.

- **Local File Access / Path Traversal** (high) [CWE-22]: The commit restricts local file access in headless protocol, requiring explicit -lfa flag and blocking file:// scheme by default, preventing arbitrary file read.
  - sink: `FilesInput action with file:// scheme`
  - fix: Gate FilesInput behind AllowLocalFileAccess flag; block file:// scheme in headless fetch requests unless -lfa is set
  - commit: https://github.com/AmirulAndalib/nuclei/commit/d3928e080d819f25306bfbaecc399f03516db5aa (2023-08-25)
- **Path Traversal** (high) [CWE-22]: This commit adds sandboxing for payload file paths, preventing arbitrary file reads via path traversal when the sandbox is enabled.
  - sink: `loadPayloadsFromFile`
  - fix: Path canonicalization and prefix check against template directory
  - commit: https://github.com/AmirulAndalib/nuclei/commit/e7fb40a41308f6c41267e858d1781eb67f7e0572 (2022-11-16)
- **Sandbox Escape** (high) [CWE-250]: This commit disables the headless browser sandbox only when necessary (Linux root), preventing sandbox escape for other users.
  - sink: `NoSandbox`
  - fix: Conditional sandbox disabling based on OS and user privileges
  - commit: https://github.com/AmirulAndalib/nuclei/commit/df55f7a2eb591a7949b5c66a9c54db54aa28f450 (2021-12-05)
- **Path Traversal** (high) [CWE-22]: Fixes a zip-slip path traversal vulnerability in template extraction.
  - sink: `filepath.Join(templateDirectory, name)`
  - fix: Path canonicalization and prefix check via calculateTemplateAbsolutePath
  - commit: https://github.com/AmirulAndalib/nuclei/commit/f9c214a66f37a00fc29fe64232b690e6285ec59c (2021-11-25)
- **Sandbox Escape** (high) [CWE-265]: Adds a sandbox flag to restrict workflow script imports, preventing arbitrary command execution through unsafe modules.
  - sink: `script.SetImports(stdlib.GetModuleMap(stdlib.AllModuleNames()...))`
  - fix: Adds sandbox flag to restrict imports to a safe module allowlist
  - commit: https://github.com/AmirulAndalib/nuclei/commit/cf2a98b03d76327c20fb0183b7f1c849eb692c91 (2020-12-13)
- **Sandbox Escape** (high) [CWE-265]: Restricts workflow script imports to a safe allowlist, preventing arbitrary command execution through unsafe modules.
  - sink: `script.SetImports(stdlib.GetModuleMap(stdlib.AllModuleNames()...))`
  - fix: Restricts workflow script imports to a safe module allowlist
  - commit: https://github.com/AmirulAndalib/nuclei/commit/96049a32fa70aef0483d4180d386a57b3c2d973a (2020-12-13)
